name: Transformers.js
description: Hugging Face's JS library running ONNX models in browser (WASM/WebGPU) and Node via onnxruntime; v4 is current (@huggingface/transformers).

restrictions: Each model has its own licence (all-MiniLM-L6-v2: Apache-2.0)

bundleSize.source: library plus model files: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 quantised ~23 MB (HF repo listing)

cost.notes: Model download on first use, cached by browser.

verdictReason: Standard way to do local embeddings; loads models from HF Hub (network once) so keep it an optional peer.
